quest.title: Chorus of Solace
quest.description: You have defeated Zala. Go look for Nastya now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nastya!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me. Actually, I should say that I feel very good right now, because I saw Doctor Moreau...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I saw him, and he even praised me. He said he could see that I am working really hard to get home with help from both of you.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: He said I was amazing, and that I could turn into part of the Perfect Tree too. And I... I could feel mama too... Even though her hug felt a bit different...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: But I know that mama was there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Doctor Moreau? Nastya's mom? But there's no one here except Nastya!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: You can't see them, Paimonka. You have to be family to feel them...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Because... Ah, because... The Perfect Tree is a life that transcends all time and all life. It is... eternity.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Thank you. Nastya is no longer alone... Nastya is "us." And now, or perhaps then too, Nastya has always been part of "us."

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: It is only at this very moment that she has returned to our embrace. On the level of the eternal, all is connected. Thank you for your help, especially you...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: #Descender, the fourth, one half of the twins, and now the one who stands unique in {M#his}{F#her} position.

choices.text: You are not Nastya, are you?

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: We have had countless names, though words like "before" and "past" no longer hold any meaning for us. But I am the thing you seek or pursue. The thing. That person.

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: For your ease of understanding, you may call me Koshchei or Doctor Moreau. There is no real difference between the two. Especially now, less than ever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so you're the baddie in this story!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We want Goggles' power back! And Nastya, too! You're not allowed to use Nastya's body like that!

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: ...The Eye of Graeae, or "Primordial Human." The return of its power was a thing that was bound to happen eventually. But fate will take a turn. I, or we, had originally thought...

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: That the one who would appear here would be someone else — Aksinya. But now, you have been chosen to take her place and do what she was meant to do.

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: Take it. The ritual is already complete. I, or we, have no use for that power anymore, for we are already eternal. We are a life that is, in concept, infinitely close to eternity.

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: Even this brief moment of speech between us will not matter. Across all eternity, all words will lose their meaning. Everything will lose its meaning.

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: Ah, but... O everlasting dream, everlasting dream. A courtyard devoid of meaning and therefore entirely without suffering... For what reason did I seek eternity? Was it for... for...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You have forgotten what you wanted.

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: ...Because wanting has lost all meaning.

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: O Eternity, that cold and merciless far shore, where even the fiercest love cannot reach.

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: I, we, shall return that power.

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: But... all of this shall still end in a way no one wishes to see...

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: What do you mean?

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: You shall come to understand. At the very end, in the very beginning, it was your design, your choice. You chose the Descender. Is this be your final struggle, or merely a coincidence of fate...?

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: Such brief suffering. I shall return, return to among "us." Nastya, you still have a little time before you become "us."

response.speaker: Thing That Used to be Nastya
response.text: Go say goodbye to them. Though in the end, or at the end of time, after annihilation, we shall all become the same thing in any case.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Um... Okay. I'll take a minute to do that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nastya?

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: #Paimonka, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, thank you for bringing me home.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Now I can become part of the Perfect Tree. I can be just like everybody else, and be with my mama again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Nastya, if you turn into the Perfect Tree, we won't be able to play together anymore. Or, uh, run around in the woods, or eat yummy food together.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: That's okay, Paimonka. It'd be so awesome if I could do all that, yes, but there's something more important I have to do.

choices.text: Is this... really what you want?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right, Nastya. There are so, so many fun things to do outside, and so many wonderful things to see too. Just come with us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And, and, that ritual thing Koshchei set up... Goggles! Goggles must have a way to fix it, right?

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: Yes... The ritual can be dismantled. While what has already been changed cannot be reversed, once the ritual stops, life's form will not continue to transform.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Nastya, you do know that you can still live a wonderful life without turning into the Perfect Tree, right...? And you can leave the rest to {NICKNAME} and me. We can keep you safe!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: #Yeah... I know all that, Paimonka. I know what you and {M#Big brother}{F#Big sister} {NICKNAME} can do for me.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Aunt LePuy, "No-Nose" Ove, and Furiosa, they have all told me about the world outside... It sounds so interesting that I want to go on adventures out there too.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: But what made me happiest was coming home every day, falling into bed, then... telling mama about the day I had. About how I played with my friends, and all the fun stories I heard...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: And when I talked, mama always looked at me with those eyes that made me feel all warm and nice inside.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: I just want to see those eyes just one more time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Nastya has made her choice.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Heh, I know. Sometimes, when the two of you look at me, it makes me feel all nice and warm inside too.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: I'm sure there are lots of people in the outside world with the same kind of eyes. But mama is mama...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: I'm so happy I met the two of you before I turn into the Perfect Tree. When I see mama, I'll definitely tell her about you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay then... Goodbye, Nastya. Goodbye!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Goodbye! Don't worry about me, Paimonka. We'll see each other again in the world beyond eternity!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: From the girl's waving hand comes a light, and a disintegration, that then spread to the rest of her being.\nThe light grows, then dims, transforming into that glowing blue algae you have seen earlier along the way.\nHer body is changing faster than expected. That brief confusion in her eyes turns into joy.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The girl who is now glowing from top to toe appears to be taking a step toward you... Or perhaps that was just a momentary loss of balance on her part.\nHer body falls to the ground in an almost weightless manner, and by the time she touches the ground, she has already become blue algae.\n...And it looks just like all that blue algae you have seen along the way here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nastya...

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: This is the final form of the Perfect Tree... The eternal form of life Koshchei seeks to create.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: It cannot move, cannot speak, and even its very form of life has been transformed, stripping everything of meaning. All that remains is eternity, and a life that no longer knows either joy or love...

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: Ah, I sense that all the power from the grand ritual in this area has been recovered... and it is now in that enormous egg. The egg that is... a part of my body.

choices.text: All you have to do is say no...

talks.objective: Obtain a part of the Eye of Graeae's body

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's part of your body...?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: I'm guessing it's a part of my power that my body has coalesced into this form... like some kind of crystal. Probably because it might not be a very pleasant sight if you have to carry my entire body around otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, you're probably right. We'll put it away for now then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right... Zala. That huge firebird.. Don't people say that firebirds can come back to life again and again?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...Indeed. And since that creature is wholly a bio-alchemical creation, it probably does not rely on my power for its core.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then.. then what if it decides there's nothing left here to protect and gets super-duper mad? What if it decides to go off and destroy everything???

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That is a real possibility. Man-made monsters generally do not possess a very high level of intelligence...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no, we have to head out and make sure that doesn't happen!
...So. You chose to merge "it" with the plants after all, Koshchei.
O firebird, firebird... Oh how you sing in the night, dance in a palace of glass-like ice and snow, then bow your head in song to feast upon the golden fruit.
Ah, you're here. Are you worried it might revive again? I've made a few small adjustments. Its body will soon break down and disintegrate.
Ultimately, if a man-made monster cannot transcend all things, it is no more than the body of an ordinary monster.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you, thank you... That's a huge help!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, hold on... who are you again?
Oh, that's right. Though I already know who you are, I suppose I have yet to introduce myself to you...
I am but a lowly "Royal Jester" who once served His Majesty, the late Belyi Tsar. My name, insignificant as it is, is Aksinya.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Aksinya...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Yes. Does that serve to refresh your memory?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Izmaylo is always complaining that my introductions are far too humble. But personally? I just see it as a deliberate choice of style.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "Aksinya"... That name sounds very familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Well, that happens to be the name of the person who built the mechanism you're residing in right now, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You... are the one who made Goggles?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Yes, that is I.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Haha, so you see, "Goggles" belongs to me. Do be good and return it now, you little thieves!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huhhhhh????

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I'm only teasing. Feel free to keep "him" with you.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: In that grand design, it was also I who was supposed to obtain the Eye of Graeae along with the will inside it. But since "he" has made "his" choice...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I believe in the Eye of Graeae, and I also believe in you, the ones "he" has chosen.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: That's enough of an introduction. Our goal is the same... to help the will inside the Eye of Graeae find its body and reclaim its power.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: That is what you want, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Then we shall cross paths again on the journey ahead. Ah, it is almost time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Time for what...?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: "The fallen leaves rustle at our feet, as winter begins to lay down its offerings"...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: ...It's almost time, everyone. Out in the fields, the last blooming flower is about to wither.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hold on, hold on!!! We still have so many questions——

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And she's gone... just like that. Hmph, what a strange lady! Goggles, how are you doing? Did seeing her remind you of anything at all?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: A few things. But they're... only vague impressions for now. It was her, along with Koshchei and two other people who created me. That was at...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...an organization called the Alypium.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: That is all I can remember for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Okay then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's alright. She did say we'll see her again later anyway... So, when we do, we'll just make her tell us everything!

dialogues.speaker: Blue Algae
dialogues.text: So I'm back here again... It looks just like before, except that seed looks like it's about to sprout, and new leaves are also growing...

dialogues.speaker: Blue Algae
dialogues.text: My little bed... is now being used by another life... My blanket... My pillow, and my toys...

dialogues.speaker: Blue Algae
dialogues.text: It doesn’t feel like my little corner anymore? But... this feels so strange. Mama is already here beside me, so why do I still miss it..?.

dialogues.speaker: Blue Algae
dialogues.text: I can feel mama's hand stroking my hair. It hasn't turned into beautiful leaves and branches yet, but mama loves me all the same... "Good children go to sleep early," she says...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Is that Nastya? I don't know if there's a way we can talk to her, though...)
